notes: family: hidden-role-social. No points; each player ticks 'won' for their final faction (after conversions). Eliminated players still win with their team. Ship position, conversions and sacrifices are not tracked. Player count 5-11 (3 Sailors+1 Pirate+1 Cult Leader or 2+2+1 at 5 players). Verified against the official rulebook (Victory Conditions, p.8; Feed the Kraken action p.13 of the PDF text).
winCondition: Sailors win at Bluewater Bay; Pirates win at Crimson Cove; the Cult (Cult Leader and Cultists) wins if the ship reaches the Kraken or when the Cult Leader is sacrificed on a Feed the Kraken space (immediate win). Players win with their team even if eliminated/overboard earlier. The Cult Leader cannot win by jumping overboard as navigator.

roles.label: Sailor
roles.winCondition: Ship reaches Bluewater Bay (blue area, east).

roles.label: Pirate
roles.winCondition: Ship reaches Crimson Cove (red area, west).

roles.label: Cult Leader
roles.winCondition: Ship reaches the Kraken (north), or the Cult Leader is sacrificed on a Feed the Kraken space.

roles.label: Cultist (converted)
roles.winCondition: Wins or loses with the Cult Leader; no longer a Sailor or Pirate.

endCondition.description: Navigation rounds repeat until the ship reaches a destination or the Cult Leader is fed to the Kraken.
